title: Oven Roasted Irish Tofu Casserole
description: A comforting and crispy Irish dish featuring sweet chilli sauce and sashimi-cut tofu, perfect for a cold evening. This vegan-friendly casserole is sure to become a favorite.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into sashimi-style pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the tofu pieces with sweet chilli sauce until they are evenly coated.
In a separate bowl, mix together the irish oatmeal, vegetable oil, onion, garlic, mushrooms, nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper.

In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of the oatmeal mixture, followed by a layer of the tofu pieces, and repeat this process until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of oatmeal on top.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the top is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
